summary: A Crouch End letting agent appears to lose landlords to a default page title, a 2015 copyright date and no quick message option.

findings.problem: The page title appears as HOME | index, a default Wix name, and not Traynor and Co.
findings.cost: This is what Google and browser tabs show, so landlords searching for an agent do not see who you are.
findings.fix: A title with your firm name and Crouch End.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say 2015 Traynor and Co Ltd.
findings.cost: An old date makes a landlord wonder if the agent is still active, even for a firm managing half a billion pounds of property.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp or online valuation form appears, only the Contact page.
findings.cost: Landlords with a quick question message first, and the agent who answers first gets the instruction.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button and a valuation form.
